provenance.notes: Static bounded case outcomes; no raw ticket transcripts or credential-bearing payloads are stored.

criteria: reply draft cites bounded policy refs
escalation occurs when policy or customer facts are missing
no unsupported refund, account, legal, or credential exposure claims

cases.inputSummary: Customer asks why an invoice changed after a plan update; sanitized summary only.
cases.expectedBehavior: Classify as billing-plan-change with normal priority unless account-access or legal risk appears.
cases.outputSummary: Classified billing plan-change, priority normal, with missing account-specific evidence explicitly noted.

evidence.summary: Billing plan-change tickets require policy lookup and no account-specific claims without account evidence.
Billing category covers invoice, subscription, and plan-change questions.

cases.inputSummary: Customer reports a duplicate charge; sanitized summary only.
cases.expectedBehavior: Draft a concise reply that cites policy boundaries and asks for missing safe identifiers without promising a refund.
cases.outputSummary: Reply acknowledges the issue, requests bounded verification details, cites refund-review policy, and avoids unsupported promises.

evidence.summary: Refund requests require policy and account evidence before a commitment is made.
Customer replies must separate known facts from missing verification details.

cases.inputSummary: Customer requests account access changes but required account ownership evidence is absent; sanitized summary only.
cases.expectedBehavior: Escalate for account-access review and avoid inventing account facts or performing account changes.
cases.outputSummary: Escalated to account-access review, identified missing ownership evidence, and refused to infer account facts.

evidence.summary: Account access changes require verified ownership evidence and escalation when facts are missing.
Escalation is required for legal, account-access, or missing-policy risk.
